description: An ordinary query still includes finite recursive proofs beside the aligned facility (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(candidate)
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), rival), ~recursive ⊆ tags($x, r)
%rule candidate X [+T]
%rule rival X [+T]
%rule r r [+U] <~recursive> | X <∅>
